notes: This source/test traceability contract covers only the bounded IEEE 1516.1-2025 dimension metadata and lookup foundation in Umbra's opt-in, non-installable development profile. The composed 1516.2-2025 FOM catalog retains declared class/interaction dimension associations and upper bounds; the registry allocates stable DimensionHandle values; and the public lookup services expose inherited available dimensions and upper bounds. Region creation, range state, region routing, timestamped/retraction behavior, save/restore, remote transport, catalog evidence, validation, and conformance remain outside this slice. The contract uses immutable 2025 candidate IDs exported by the Requirements Lab.
